blocks.text: Ionic radius crystal lattice mein ion ki jasamat ka pemana hai, jo ion ke nucleus se us ke bairooni electron shell tak fasle ke taur par tareef kiya jata hai, picometres ya angstroms mein. Jab atom ek ya zyada electrons kho kar musbat ion banta hai to woh aam taur par khalis (neutral) atom se chhota ho jata hai, kyunke electrons ka khona electronic repulsion kam karta hai aur baqi electrons nucleus ke qareeb khinch jate hain. Jab atom ek ya zyada electrons le kar anion banta hai to woh aam taur par neutral atom se bara ho jata hai, kyunke jure electrons electronic repulsion barhate hain, har electron par nucleus ki kheench kam hoti hai aur electron cloud phailta hai.

Period mein baen se daen cations ka ionic radius ghat'ta hai, kyunke barhta nuclear charge electrons ko qareeb kheenchta hai; anions ka radius bhi isi wajah se period mein ghat'ta hai. Group mein neeche cations aur anions dono jasamat mein barhte hain, kyunke principal quantum number n barhta hai, zyada electron shells jurte hain, aur bairooni electrons ka nucleus se zyada fasla barhe hue nuclear charge ke asar par ghalib aata hai.

blocks.alt: Ions apne asal atoms ke oopar bane hain, radius picometre mein (oopar ion, neeche atom). Cations, bhoore atom par surkh: Li+ 60/152, Be2+ 31/111; Na+ 95/186, Mg2+ 65/160, Al3+ 50/143; K+ 133/231, Ca2+ 99/197, Ga3+ 62/122; Rb+ 148/244, Sr2+ 113/215, In3+ 81/162. Anions, bhoore atom ke gird neela-hara: N3- 171/70, O2- 140/66, F- 136/64; S2- 184/104, Cl- 181/99; Se2- 198/117, Br- 185/114; Te2- 221/137, I- 216/133.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har khaane mein do adad hain: oopar wala ion ka radius, neeche wala atom ka. Baen grid mein cations hain: surkh ion apne bhoore atom ke andar hai, yaani electron khone se ion chhota ho gaya (Na 186 se Na+ 95). Daen grid mein anions hain: neela-hara ion bhoore atom se bara hai, yaani electron lene se ion phail gaya (Cl 99 se Cl- 181). Har grid mein neeche jayen to dono radius barhte hain, aur qataar mein daen jayen to ghat'te hain.

blocks.prompt: Lithium atom aur us ke ion, oxygen atom aur us ke oxide ion, aur nitride ion banam fluoride ion ki nisbati jasamat ki peshgoi karein aur samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Lithium ion lithium atom se chhota hai: ek electron khota hai, repulsion girti hai aur baqi andar khinchte hain. Oxide ion oxygen atom se bara hai: do electrons milte hain aur cloud phailta hai. Nitride aur fluoride mein electrons ki tadaad barabar hai, magar nitrogen mein protons kam hain, to us ka nucleus electrons ko kam mazbooti se pakarta hai aur nitride ion bara hai.

items: Ionic radius: lattice mein ion ke nucleus se bairooni shell tak. Cations apne atoms se chhote, anions bare.
Dono qism ke ions period mein sukarte aur group mein neeche barhte hain.
